title: Aye zamin e ahoo
body:
Aye zamin e ahoo
Ae zamin e ahoo..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
ahoo ki tarah..(2)
har ghadi zamin hai mera tu
<<DIVIDER>>
Ae zamin e ahoo..(4)
1. Bus isme ameeri o ghareebi ka nahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tauheed ki manind mujhe iska yaqee hai
mash'had wahi jaata hai bulata hai jise tu
<<DIVIDER>>
Ae zamin e ahoo..(4)
2. Wallah wo ek lamhe me yusuf ko bhula de
<<DIVIDER>>
angusht ke badle me wo sar apna kata de
miljae zulekha..(2) ko agar aapki khushboo
<<DIVIDER>>
Ae zamin e ahoo..(4)
3. Na sur ki samajh hai na kisi raag ki maula
<<DIVIDER>>
sab hai teri dehleez ke zarro ka ye sadqa
kehte hai ye sab hai meri aawaaz me jadoo
<<DIVIDER>>
Ae zamin e ahoo..(4)
4. Mai qabr me gar apna ta'arruf na karata
<<DIVIDER>>
maddah hu tera mai agar ye na batata
hoti na kabhi khatm malaek ki manu tu
<<DIVIDER>>
Ae zamin e ahoo..(4)
5. Wo sehne masiha hai ke hai sehen shifa ka
<<DIVIDER>>
maine waha khud apni nigaho se hai dekha
zaer tera wa maut ko kar leta hai qaboo
<<DIVIDER>>
Ae zamin e ahoo..(4)
6. Haq aapki midhat ka ada kaise karu mai
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha bhala dusra qur'an likhu mai
aati nahi jab mujhko abhi theek se urdu
<<DIVIDER>>
Ae zamin e ahoo..(4)
7. Mehsoos ye har baar mere dil ne kiya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
maula tere darbaar ki taseer juda hai
hoti hai khushi aur kabhi aajate hai aasu
<<DIVIDER>>
Ae zamin e ahoo..(4)
8. Khul jaega duniya pe tere meer ka rutba
<<DIVIDER>>
ho jaega maloom ke banda hu mai kiska
aegi meri qabr se jis dum teri khushbu
<<DIVIDER>>
Ae zamin e ahoo..(6)
author: Mir Hassan Mir
